steps.code: <?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $home = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Home', 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_content' => '' ) ); if ( $home && ! is_wp_error( $home ) ) { update_option( 'page_on_front', $home ); } $sample = get_page_by_title( 'Sample Page' ); if ( $sample ) { wp_delete_post( $sample->ID, true ); } $hello = get_page_by_title( 'Hello world!' ); if ( $hello ) { wp_delete_post( $hello->ID, true ); }
